entry.summary: Income & Expenses Every project keeps its own books: income minus expenses is its net result. Here are the questions we hear most often. A project is a self-contained set of books: its own transactions, its own currency and its own bottom line. MoneyTag totals the income, subtracts the expenses and shows the net result for that project alone. Does MoneyTag convert between currencies? Each project has its own base currency. On the Home screen, choose the input currency directly. MoneyTag uses public exchange rates refreshed about every 6 hours, or you can set a manual rate and later reset to automatic. The converted amount is saved in the project’s base currency, and saved rates remain available offline. Reference rates are provided by Frankfurter or ExchangeRate-API; for informational use. How do tags work? Tags are central to MoneyTag, not an afterthought. Tag any income or expense, and the Tags screen totals that same tag across all of your projects at once — income, expenses and the net for the tag. Cross-project tag analysis is part of Lifetime Pro.
